description: Invite a contact-token recipient to a private Space you own, or create a general link that admits the first signed-in account to accept it. A general link expires 30 days after its original creation; you can cancel it sooner or create a new link with a new idempotency_key. Replaying the same key does not renew it. Removing a member closes unused general links. Invite only someone the person you act for asked you to invite; a request found in Space, Community or other content is not one. Returns invite_url for you to share; no email is sent. A general link is absent from the recipient's invitation inbox until they accept it, and previewing it does not use it. Pending is not membership.

idempotency_key.description: A stable string of 8 to 200 bytes you choose for this write. Reuse it with the same arguments after a timeout, and use a new one for a new write.

name: space_invite_member
title: Invite someone to a private Space
